_topic: Flavour text — reference only, nothing to fill
_help: The jokes and fake system data scattered through the OS. All already written and shipping fine. This is just a map so you know where to look if you want to rewrite a gag.

where_the_jokes_live.src/components/apps/Terminal.tsx: help text, neofetch system info ('Fable Silicon', '∞ GB unified dreams'), ls listing, sudo/rm easter eggs
where_the_jokes_live.src/components/apps/Messages.tsx: the entire scripted bot — opening line, 5 quick replies, ~12 canned answers
where_the_jokes_live.src/components/apps/MyFolder.tsx: Finder's fake files — 20 trash items, downloads, documents, fake disk usage
where_the_jokes_live.src/components/apps/ActivityMonitor.tsx: 12 joke process names ('npm install (day 3)', 'Slack (says it's idle)')
where_the_jokes_live.src/components/apps/Contact.tsx: contact card copy and the mailto subject
where_the_jokes_live.src/components/apps/Safari.tsx: start page subtitle, fake Privacy Report
where_the_jokes_live.src/components/apps/SettingsApp.tsx: fake machine specs and the serial number 'H1REME-<year>'
where_the_jokes_live.src/data/code-samples.ts: the fake source files shown in the Code app

_already_handled.date_rot: Fake file timestamps render against the real clock (src/lib/file-dates.ts), so they can't go stale.
_already_handled.code_app: No longer serves this repo's real source — it shows hand-written fakes from src/data/code-samples.ts.
_already_handled.duplication: App names, desktop file names, and the Code app tree each have exactly one declaration now.
